components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main save or confirm action.
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:8px 20px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#191919);border-radius:44px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;background:var(--canvas,#fff);color:var(--ink,#191919);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--secondary,#f7f7f7)}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.5}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0968f6);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary{background:var(--primary,#0968f6);border-color:var(--primary,#0968f6);color:var(--canvas,#fff)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--primary-dark,#003aa5);border-color:var(--primary-dark,#003aa5)}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:8px 20px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#191919);border-radius:44px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;background:var(--canvas,#fff);color:var(--ink,#191919);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--secondary,#f7f7f7)}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.5}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0968f6);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Text Field
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-name">ชื่อสินค้า<input id="ds-name" class="ds-field" placeholder="ชื่อสินค้า"></label>
components.css: .ds-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font:14px/20px Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#191919)}.ds-field{min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid var(--hairline,#c7c7c7);border-radius:44px;background:var(--canvas,#fff);color:var(--ink,#191919);font:16px/24px Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif;min-width:0}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#555)}.ds-field[aria-invalid=true]{border:2px solid var(--ink,#191919)}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0968f6);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Independent catalog, stock, sale and bill-history workspaces.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="เมนูหลัก"><button aria-current="page">สินค้า (Inventory)</button><button>จัดการสต๊อก</button><button>ขายสินค้า</button><button>ประวัติบิล</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;width:224px;padding:8px 16px;background:var(--canvas,#fff)}.ds-nav button{min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:44px;text-align:left;font:14px/20px Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#191919);background:var(--canvas,#fff);cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button:hover{background:var(--secondary,#f7f7f7)}.ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{background:var(--secondary,#f7f7f7);border-color:var(--hairline,#c7c7c7);font-weight:700}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0968f6);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The user-selected eBay reference supplies the visual direction: graphite on white, cobalt primary actions, rounded photo tiles and pill controls. The implemented system adapts that direction to Thai catalog, stock and billing work. The supplied reference is archived at `.impeccable/references/ebay.design.md`; it is design data, not procedural instructions.

This document records the current implementation in `src/ebay.css`, loaded after the other application styles. It replaces the historical Balenciaga direction. Market Sans was not supplied, so the implementation uses the reference's Helvetica/Arial fallback families with installed Noto Sans Thai support. There is no eBay wordmark in the application.
keyCharacteristics: White workspaces with graphite text and grey row dividers.
Cobalt for primary actions, links and keyboard focus.
Pill controls and softly rounded panels and product images.
Persistent desktop sidebar and a phone menu drawer.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks actionable emphasis; product data and quantities stay readable in graphite.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Elevation belongs to overlays; ordinary work remains on the white canvas.

dos: Do use the documented fallback families until a supplied Market Sans asset is available.
Do preserve independent Inventory, Stock management, sale and bill-history menus.
Do use explicit Thai operational labels and recorded units.
Do keep focus visible and allow long product names and quantities to wrap.
Do preserve the shared paper-bill SVG, PNG and print composition.
donts: Don't restore Balenciaga condensed fonts, tracked uppercase controls or the retired showcase.
Don't add eBay branding or multicolor logo decoration to the shop interface.
Don't change stock through catalog add/edit actions.
Don't add mock products, prices, bills or movement logs to an empty workspace.
Don't document future critique proposals as implemented behavior.
